study type: Repeated cross-sectional study (analysis of pooled survey data)
exposure: Mothers' personal healthcare autonomy within the household
outcome: Child treatment for acute respiratory infection
cohort: The study analyzed data from mothers and their children under 3 years from three consecutive waves of the Nigeria Demographic and Health Survey (2008, 2013, 2018).
finding: Mothers' health autonomy and healthcare utilization were generally positively associated with child immunization and treatment of morbidities (except diarrhoea), with some relationships moderated by media exposure or family wealth.
cross-section timing: Data pooled from surveys conducted in 2008, 2013, and 2018.
